item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

params.prompt_or_change: Minimal flat vector logo for a cycling club: a small bicycle wheel with subtle moss fronds integrated into its upper rim, above the exact words "Moss & Mile" in clean dark forest-green sans-serif lettering; restrained sage accents, warm white background, generous negative space, crisp simple shapes, one standalone logo only.

steps.why: Create the first standalone logo with a nature-and-cycling symbol.

params.prompt_or_change: Refined outdoor-club vector logo: a small winding trail passing between two simple hills inside a compact diamond symbol, above the exact words "Moss & Mile" in elegant charcoal slab-serif lettering; muted ochre symbol, ivory background, spacious balanced composition, no wheel imagery, one standalone logo only.

steps.why: Create a distinct second logo built around a trail rather than a wheel.

params.prompt_or_change: Bold contemporary vector cycling-club logo: a small angular "MM" monogram whose strokes subtly evoke bicycle frame geometry, above the exact words "Moss & Mile" in bold black geometric sans-serif lettering; black and muted rust on white, crisp compact symbol and generous negative space, no wheels or landscape imagery, one standalone logo only.

steps.why: Create a third logo with a typographic cycling symbol and a different visual identity.
